BASE_COHERENCE_RULE: a z-score requires numerator and denominator on the SAME base. A COVER margin is MARKET-referenced (actual vs the line); a model residual SD is MODEL-referenced. Dividing one by the other is a rough gauge, not a z-score, and must be labelled as such.
CLAIM_WITHDRAWN: a '12.53 measured against covers' value has been referenced. No such artifact exists in this repo. There is NO measured cover-based SD anywhere. The only measured ~12.55 figure is the MARGIN RESIDUAL SD.
